name: Thai Coconut Public Company Limited
summary: Thai Coconut Public Company Limited produces and distributes coconut products in Asia, the United States, Europe, the Middle East, Oceania, and Africa. The company operates through three segments: Coconut Milk, Coconut Water, and Pet Food. It offers Thai food, desserts, and street food products.
